exploratory_saved_action_diagnostic.definition: Before action t, seen-hidden means the selected position was visible in some preceding public frame but equals hidden token 13 in frame t. Correct rank is taken only from the actual returned frame t+1 at the selected action. Argmax/probability use saved raw pre-action memory distribution. A repeated mismatch is any unordered pair already observed to mismatch earlier in that episode, regardless of intervening events. No future or unobserved deck labels are consulted. Accuracy is pooled over selected seen-hidden actions; development uses episode/boundary/card weighting, so the two are not identically weighted populations.

interpretation.descriptive_retrieval_signal: The five non-GRU learned families have about 92.4%-93.1% development seen-hidden accuracy, 62.3%-66.5% age > 32 accuracy and 99.59%-99.75% selected on-policy seen-hidden accuracy. They nevertheless solve 0/192 each; these retrieval measurements do not establish control utility.
interpretation.exploratory_action_pattern: Local covers 38.6927 positions on average and repeats 236 already-failed pairs across 192 games. GRU covers 6.7448 positions and repeats 8,499 failed pairs, with selected hidden accuracy 0.10922. Exact reference covers 52 positions with 0 repeat failures; last32 covers 52 with 5 repeat failures.
interpretation.local_rankings: Local has the highest learned family mean return by 0.002103 over gated delta, far below 0.03. Delta has higher old-card development accuracy (0.665166 versus0.630470). Local also misses both diffuse-control margins and both all-pairs requirements.
interpretation.numerical_picker_caveat: Source card_memory_task.py probabilities accepts row sums within 1e-5, copies float32 softmax values to float64 without renormalization, and choose uses exact computed-score ties. A known/unseen pair score is sum(p)/13, so row-sum error can alter mathematically tied exploration scores. Its actual causal contribution was not measured in this review; no counterfactual decision selection was performed.

limits: No fresh inference, native replay, training, RNG, or checkpoint choice. Hash-bound evaluation source and saved predictions are authenticated; neural forward mapping is not independently recomputed.

All criteria and all paired fits retained. Only coverage passed; the candidate did not qualify. Local had the numerically highest learned native return, but differences are below both prespecified margins and not positive in every paired fit.

Every learned family solved 0/192 games, across all three paired fits; both public symbolic references solved 64/64. Neither the local mechanism nor learned memory utility is qualified by these results.

Selected seen-hidden accuracy is about 99.6% for local/delta/Kalman variants, versus lower development accuracy, while exploration coverage and native utility remain poor. Selected-action accuracy concerns a policy-chosen subset and a different weighting, not all hidden cards; it cannot identify the cause or establish globally accurate memory, convergence, or calibrated probabilities.
GRU has far more parameters and this single fixed training recipe failed. It does not establish a general GRU limit.

Any next pilot must be prospectively specified with fresh evaluation seeds. Do not tune the innovation mechanism or picker on these 64 seeds. First test the causal memory-to-action interface with fixed saved memory weights, exact public symbolic reference, and predeclared probability-normalized versus hard-rank/exploration controls; this is a proposed new diagnostic, not a result or a qualified continuation of the failed mechanism.
review_type: independent saved artifact and arithmetic review; no native/model/RNG calls
